messages:
marta: quick async standup – kernel warmup / batching / kv notes

marta: yesterday: ran a longer warmup experiment on small shards (20m) to stress slot rebalancing. saw p95 regressions when we hit slot churn. attached logs in the perf job.

alex: can you paste the exact command you used to run the perf harness?

marta: sure — gist of the command:
```bash
./perf-run --model=redwood-8b --seq=512 --microbatch=4 --warmup=1200 --slots=auto --log-level=debug
```

marta: notes: the hotspots line up with KV eviction spikes at ~t=600s, and a microbatch padding increase (more padding when slot count fluctuates).

sam: interesting — did you try the quick fix from PR #3214 that pins slot allocation during warmup?

marta: I did a run with the PR applied. it reduced the padding variance but we still saw a tail spike at p99. attaching the diff: small change in slot allocator backoff and a guard around resume.

jen: fwiw I saw a similar p95 blip in last night's smoke run, traced to `kv.prefetch_worker` thrashing when many short seq requests hit. maybe related.

marta: yes, same pattern — short requests + high concurrency => prefetch queue overload => extra latency. I think throttling prefetch concurrency or batching-prefetch could help.

alex: can we try decreasing prefetch concurrency from 32 to 8 in config for the next canary? quick toggle in `/etc/redwood/runtime.toml` under [kv] prefetch_concurrency.

sam: +1. I can stage a config change on a small canary pool. will run the same perf-run command and post results.

ci-bot: test-run queued: perf-job-174999A (canary pool) — ETA ~18m. logs will appear in https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/174999A

jen: also leaving a note to the reviewers — PR 3214 needs another review for the allocator guard, @alex can you take a look? small, but touches hot path.

alex: will do later today, tagging it on my queue.

marta: blockers: need approval to roll config change to the canary (sam has creds), and need a second reviewer on PR 3214.

sam: I have creds, starting run now. will report p50/p95/p99 when finished.

jen: non-blocking FYI — I added a short test to simulate many short seqs hitting prefetch_worker; pushed to branch `kv-prefetch-simul`. helps reproduce locally.

marta: thanks. today: await canary results, collect heap/alloc traces around t=600s, and draft a small mitigation (reduce prefetch concurrency + backpressure). will post a quick follow-up once results are in.

alex: ack. if canary shows improvement, we can roll to wider pool with a canary metric gate.

sam: perf job finished — summary: p95 down 12% with prefetch=8, p99 unchanged. full logs at https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/174999A/logs (I'll paste trimmed stats later).

marta: great — that suggests prefetch concurrency helps p95. will follow up with a micro mitigation plan and a proposed rollout (canary -> 10% -> 50%).

jen: thanks team, will queue a CR for PR 3214 and the config change.

marta: end of update. :rocket:
